description: Took it as the spring's best, and kept the boys off the sheet.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Took the coin, and would not wait on a beam.
name: George Bryan

description: Gave the doors as the cause, and would not price a beam.
name: James Burbage

description: Named forty, refused the lease a place on the sheet, and shut the book.
name: John Heminges

description: Took forty, and would not average it with last Saturday.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Took the same forty, and asked no second head for the dancing.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said forty back, left the chest uncounted, and kept Allen off the sheet.
name: William Shakespeare
